title: Ocean Plastic 60
script:
Every year, eight million tons of plastic flow into our oceans. [Visual: aerial view ocean waves]
Where does it all come from? [Visual: motion_s2]
It drifts for decades, breaking into tiny fragments. [Visual: plastic trash beach shore]
The journey spans generations. [Visual: motion_s4]
Marine animals mistake it for food. [Visual: sea turtle underwater]
But change is possible. Start today. [Visual: volunteers beach cleanup]
